summary: 20-year-old solo backpacker new to Colorado set out for Willow Lake at the base of Kit Carson unprepared for winter weather; ten hours for the five-mile hike left him hypothermic, frost-bitten, and unable to walk with no feeling in his feet; REACH 71 from Alamosa attempted an NVG landing then inserted two Alamosa Volunteer SAR rescuers before midnight; the ground team reached his campsite at 4:00 AM and REACH extracted him by 10:30 AM; he showed signs of acute mountain sickness.
location: Willow Lake, base of Kit Carson
responding_agency: Saguache County SAR; Alamosa Volunteer Search and Rescue; REACH Air Medical; CSAR state coordinators
notes: Mission spanned overnight 2024-11-17 to 2024-11-18 (notified 9:30 PM Nov 17, extracted ~10:30 AM Nov 18). Recorded at the call date. Conejos County Citizen staff report (Nov. 17-18, Sangre de Cristo Range, Crestone/Baca Grande area, AVSAR-led helicopter extraction) corroborates the overnight timeline; it names Eagle Air Med rather than REACH 71 and lists South Fork Fire Rescue and Chaffee SAR as participating agencies. | run 833: AVSAR mission post merged (parent-opened, full-string absence verified)
